entries.text: When the document looks right in the preview on the right, the PDF looks the same: same theme, same cover page, same page breaks. markoto builds the file for you and downloads it. No print dialog, no fiddling with margins.

entries.caption: The topbar menu opens, "PDF (.pdf)" is one of the file actions.
Click "PDF (.pdf)" to create and download the file
markoto renders the PDF and your browser downloads it. A new render takes a few seconds; asking again without changes is instant.
The downloaded PDF opens with the same cover page as the preview.

next.why: Now lock the doc down, share it only with people you trust
